title: Three Young Women in 1940s Fashion, 1948 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A clear black and white snapshot taken on July 5, 1948, featuring three young women posing together in a grassy field. The central figure wears an elaborate white ruffled gown, possibly for a wedding, prom, or special celebration, flanked by two friends wearing classic late-1940s day dresses. In the background, utility poles and a long brick building stretch across the landscape, capturing everyday post-WWII American life.
